author: The Current
description:
For the first time ever, the Hispanic Heritage Awards took place in Minneapolis on Thursday, Sept. 10. We quizzed the honorees Ximena Sariñana, Oscar D'Leon, Mon Laferte, Eladio Carrión, and Los Tigres del Norte on what they know about Minnesota. 

#TheCurrent #HispanicHeritageAwards
title: Quizzing Hispanic Heritage Awards honorees about Minnesota
